one_line: Open-source (Magento Open Source) and commercial (Adobe Commerce) e-commerce platform with a broad REST API and GraphQL.
auth_notes: REST API supports OAuth 1.0a for third-party apps, integration access tokens, and admin/customer login tokens; Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service requires Adobe IMS (Identity Management System) access tokens signed per request.
self_serve_notes: Magento Open Source is free to self-host, so a dev can install it and generate integration tokens freely; Adobe Commerce (commercial/cloud) requires a paid license. Token generation needs store admin access.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Hundreds of REST endpoints (catalog, products, inventory, orders, customers, carts, quotes, shipments, invoices, integrations, stores) plus GraphQL API; cloud version exposes a smaller subset
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks supported in Adobe Commerce 2.4.6+/cloud (commercial); Magento Open Source has no first-class webhook system without extensions

existing_mcp.note: No official Adobe MCP server; community MCP servers for Magento exist on GitHub/MCP registries

evidence.note: Fetched text confirms REST API framework shared across Magento Open Source / Adobe Commerce, OAuth 1.0a + tokens auth, IMS auth for cloud, GraphQL for cloud

agent_notes: Auth is flexible but token generation requires admin access to a store; self-hosting Open Source is the free path. Webhooks only on commercial editions.
